meta.listDescription: Recent Deadlock matches by hero, player, result, length, date and rank, plus what’s live in the watch tab.
meta.detailDescription: Deadlock match {id}: result, teams, players, timeline, builds and events, from the match data.

list.title: Matches
list.description: Recent normal-mode matches processed by the data source. Filter to a hero or player to see results from their side.
list.result: Result (for the selected hero or player)
list.resultHint: Pick a hero or player first: a result needs a side.
list.choosePlayer: Players matching “{query}”. Choose one to filter the list:
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No matches} one {# match} other {# matches}}
list.resultFilter: ({result, select, win {wins} other {losses}} among the {fetched} most recent)
list.emptyDescription: Nothing processed yet for these filters. Widen the date range, rank band or length, or clear the result filter.

live.title: Live now
live.summary: <num>{total}</num> normal-mode matches in the in-game watch tab ({ranked} ranked)
live.region: Live matches, swipe or use arrow keys
live.note: The watch tab lists the top 200 live matches, not every match being played. Refreshes about once a minute.

explorer.caption: Recent matches. Select a row to preview it; use the up and down arrow keys to move.

detail.heading: Match {id}: {result}
detail.notAvailableDescription: This match isn’t in the data source. Very recent matches can take a while to be processed; older ones may never have been collected.
detail.timelineDescription: Objectives, the Mid-Boss, kills and the focused player’s purchases on one time axis. Select a marker or drag the scrubber; the readout shows the state at that moment.
detail.graphsDescription: Team totals at each recorded sample.
detail.eventsDescription: Every recorded event in order. Selecting one also focuses it on the timeline.

story.title: Match story
story.description: Measured facts per phase. Phase edges sit on the game’s stat samples (9:00 and 20:00); souls leads are read at those samples.
story.neverChanged: The souls lead never changed hands between samples.
story.changed: The souls lead changed hands {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} ({list}).
story.swing: Largest swing: {team} gained {value} souls of lead between {from} and {to}.

teams.title: Team comparison
teams.description: Totals at the end of the match.

players.title: Players
players.description: Final values. Names are public Steam names where available.

lineup.title: Hero lineup
lineup.description: Heroes by team and assigned lane.

builds.title: Builds
builds.description: Every shop item each player bought, in order. Faded = sold before the match ended.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: Each player’s share of the match maximum for that metric.

advanced.title: Advanced data
advanced.description: The measured values behind this page, as tables.
advanced.soulsPerSample: Souls per player at each sample
advanced.caption: Souls per player at each sample time
advanced.source: Source: <link>deadlock-api.com match metadata (JSON)</link>. Stats are sampled every 3 minutes until 15:00, then every 5 minutes, plus the final moment.

graph.caption: {title}: values by time for each team

timeline.chart: Match timeline. Arrow keys move between events; Enter selects one.
timeline.leadAxis: Souls lead: Team 1 above, Team 2 below
timeline.noEvents: No events of the selected types.
